meta.name: impeccable
meta.description: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. Handles UX review, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, theming, anti-patterns, typography, fonts, spacing, layout, alignment, color, motion, micro-interactions, UX copy, error states, edge cases, i18n, and reusable design systems or tokens. Also use for bland designs that need to become bolder or more delightful, loud designs that should become quieter, live browser iteration on UI elements, or ambitious visual effects that should feel technically extraordinary. Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页与产品界面打磨得清晰美观
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想让产品界面看起来更专业、更好用
copy.tagline_en: Polish web pages and product UIs into clear, beautiful experiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your product's interface to look more professional and easier to use

howto.what: 装上后,当你提出网页或应用界面的设计、改进或审查需求,Claude 会先读取项目里的设计与产品文档来了解背景;若指令不明确,它会先提供选项菜单,否则按对应流程执行,产出设计方案、审查意见或代码改动;涉及时检查可访问性与性能,并在有限轮次内验证。
howto.when: 当你想设计、优化或改进网页与应用界面(如落地页、后台面板、设置页等),或想审查、加动效、提升性能与可访问性时,会触发;纯后端或非界面任务不会触发。

say.text: 帮我设计这个落地页的视觉方案
say.note: 读取项目文档后产出落地页视觉方案。

say.text: 请帮我审查这个设置页的 UX 与视觉层级
say.note: 按设计审查标准给出评分和改进点。

say.text: 把这个页面改得更大胆抓眼
say.note: 用 bolder 模式生成更强烈的视觉改版。

howto.what_en: For UI design, improvement, or review requests, Claude reads design/product docs, then works in matching mode, producing design proposals, review notes, or code changes; checks accessibility/performance if relevant; verifies briefly.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests to design, polish, or review a UI (website, app, dashboard), adjust style or motion, improve performance/accessibility; not for backend-only or non-UI.

say_en.text: Help me design the visual direction for this landing page.
say_en.note: Loads project docs and produces a visual design proposal.

say_en.text: Please review the UX and visual hierarchy of this settings page.
say_en.note: Runs the critique pass and lists scores with improvements.

say_en.text: Make this page bolder and more eye-catching.
say_en.note: Uses bolder mode to create a stronger visual revision.
